description: Numbered text; act by #number. ~"x" names are guesses. "Same as before" retains #numbers; region/full/fresh expands it; full is paged with offset. Verify the entity identity before editing. Before finishing, re-read and visibly verify every task constraint (filters, sort, size, quantity, date range). After an action confirms completion, stop and report it rather than re-inspecting. If #number is stale, read() and retry; if on the wrong page, back() and keep searching. open(url) returns to an earlier results page; back() can lose its query string.

fresh.description: Expand seen regions too (this call only)

full.description: Untrimmed bounded excerpt; use offset for the next excerpt

offset.description: Character offset for the next full excerpt

region.description: Label substring, e.g. "nav"; if none matches, text inside a region also works

name: read
